sentences.text: Per contra, learned A.G.A. has opposed the present application.

He submits that after lodging of F.I.R. dated 31.3.2019, registered as Case Crime No. 280 of 2019, under section 323, 324, 307, 498A IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Muradnagar, District- Ghaziabad, Investigating Officer proceeded with statutory investigation of same.
After completion of investigation, Investigating Officer has submitted charge sheet dated 21.10.2020.
In the aforesaid charge sheet, as many as 8 witnesses have been nominated.

On the aforesaid premise, learned A.G.A. submits that at this stage,
it cannot be said that prosecution case is false or there is no material to support the prosecution of applicant.
Apart from above, there is injury report of injured Sangeeta.
There is nothing on record to dislodge the same.
In view of above, learned A.G.A. contends that no indulgence be granted by this Court in favour of applicant.
When confronted with above, learned counsel for applicant could not overcome the same.
In view of above, present application fails and is liable to be dismissed.
It is accordingly dismissed.
